contexts.text: That falsities from evil would redound to them. Signified, Explained.
(Thus) is it to be understood how the falsities from evil, which are aimed at being inflicted on others, redound or relapse upon themselves.
The redounding upon them of falsities from evil at the presence of the Lord. Signified, Explained.
The redundancy which is superfluous in the curtains of the Tent () = that which proceeds. Explained. AC 9628. AC 9629.
From the faith of the present Church there flows forth freely the worship of the mouth.
Some feeling of it redounds (or overflows) to all the rest.
